## Layout

- `upstream/`: the upstream `skills/security-audit/` directory plus `LICENSE` and `README.md`, byte for byte. Never edit these files. The em-dashes in them are upstream text and are exempt from the writing-style rule (verbatim third-party content).
- `adf-win32/`: generated by `skills/deep-security-audit/scripts/patch-win32.cjs`. Patched copies of the two validators plus the schema and tests they require. On Windows the upstream reader rejects every input because Node exposes no `O_NOFOLLOW`. The patch falls back to lstat (no symlinks, regular files only), opens read-only and rejects the input when the fstat identity (dev, ino, size) differs from the lstat result. Other platforms run the upstream path unchanged. Regenerate after every pin bump.

The folder sits outside `skills/` on purpose. The upstream skill is named `security-audit`, which ADF retired in v4.9.0 (merged into `/audit`), so it must never register as a skill of its own.

## Updating (never automatic)

A security skill that silently pulls new prompt text is a supply-chain risk. Bump the pin only after reading the diff:

```bash
bash .claude/scripts/sync-vendor.sh cloudflare-security-audit                 # write the full diff to AI_DOCS/.temp/sync-vendor/ (skill-lab/results/ in the framework repo), change nothing
bash .claude/scripts/sync-vendor.sh cloudflare-security-audit --apply <sha>   # apply exactly the reviewed commit, regenerate adf-win32/, run the validator tests, move the pin
```

Read the full diff before `--apply`, the `.cjs` files first: `--apply` runs the upstream validator tests. After `--apply`, re-read `SKILL.md`, `HUNTING.md` and `VALIDATION-AND-REPORTING.md` for workflow changes the ADF wrapper must follow, and bump `skills/deep-security-audit` accordingly.
